steps.instruction: Show both open hands to the camera
steps.spokenPrompt: Hold up both hands with your fingers spread and palms facing the camera. Keep them visible until I confirm this step.
steps.successCriteria: Two distinct open hands are clearly visible, palms facing the camera with fingers extended and spread. A thumbs-up or closed fist does not match this step.

steps.spokenPrompt: Now lower one hand and give a thumbs-up with the other. Keep your thumb up until I confirm this step.
steps.successCriteria: One hand makes a thumbs-up: four fingers curled into the palm and the thumb extended upward. A fully open hand or a fist with the thumb folded down does not match.

steps.instruction: Make a fist and keep it visible
steps.spokenPrompt: Close that hand into a fist, with your thumb wrapped on the outside, across your fingers. Keep it in view while I count five seconds, until I say you are done.
steps.successCriteria: Exactly one closed fist is clearly visible with all four fingers curled into the palm. The thumb must be clearly visible lying across the front of the curled fingers, on the outside of the fist. If the thumb is tucked inside the fist or hidden behind the fingers, if the thumb points up, or if any finger is extended, this does not match. The other hand is lowered.
